music.notes: 16-bar original arcade funk with round bass, clavinet, drawbar chords, surf-like lead and stereo drums. Use decoded AudioBuffer loop for seamless scheduling.

crumb.use: Each collected breadcrumb; throttle to one voice per 70ms.

horn.use: Player horn; duck music briefly by 30%.

sheep.use: Timed horn cue: two comic baa syllables.

flush.use: Money drains away on a fine/collision.

brake.use: Sheep near-miss/fail transition; visual covers contact.

engine.use: Optional looping diesel ambience; rate 0.9–1.3 follows speed.

scatter.use: Sheep run safely away after a timed horn.

bonus.use: Clean driving bonus or newly unlocked item.

provenance: Entirely original procedural composition and sound design. No third-party recordings; sheep is a stylised formant-synthesised baa.
